description: This file contains helper functions for generating test Protocol Data Units (PDUs) for MAC layer testing in a 5G NR simulation environment, including creation of test PDUs with BSR and RRC setup complete messages, and functions for creating and matching UCI PDUs for different PUCCH formats.

methods.name: odu::create_test_pdu_with_bsr
methods.description: Creates a test MAC PDU with a Buffer Status Report (BSR) for testing purposes.

methods.name: odu::create_test_pdu_with_rrc_setup_complete
methods.description: Creates a test MAC PDU indicating RRC setup completion.

methods.name: odu::create_uci_pdu (pucch_info, test_ue_cfg)
methods.description: Creates a UCI PDU based on PUCCH info and test UE configuration.

methods.name: odu::create_uci_pdu (ul_sched_info, test_ue_cfg)
methods.description: Creates a UCI PDU based on uplink scheduled info and test UE configuration.

methods.name: odu::pucch_info_and_uci_ind_match
methods.description: Checks if a given pucch_info matches a UCI indication PDU.
